title: Two Undercover Angels
writer: Jesús Franco, Gert Günther Hoffmann, Luis Revenga
actors: Janine Reynaud, Rosanna Yanni, Chris Howland
plot: "Red Lips" are two female detectives trying to find missing models and dancers. A pop artist called Klaus Thriller and his werewolf-like assistant, Morpho, are the main suspects for the murderers.
